component.name: picsel
component.summary: Choose which pictures of a folder to keep

description.p: picsel helps you go through the pictures and videos of a folder quickly and decide which ones to keep. Open any picture of the folder, mark the keepers (or the rejects) with the keyboard, then move the selected files into your gallery folder.

ul.li: Fast thumbnail mosaic and full view, driven by the keyboard
Every change is saved immediately, so you can stop and continue later
Folders reopen at the picture you were on when you closed them
Sorting by date taken, with per-camera clock corrections
Bursts of similar shots are marked so you can pick the best one
Safe moves: conflicts are checked before anything is moved

screenshot.caption: Mark the pictures to keep; bursts of similar shots are grouped
Move the selected pictures to the gallery folder

ul.li: Folders reopen at the picture you were on when you closed them
Folders are sorted by date taken unless you chose name order
The selection is never reset when a folder can only be listed in part
Overwriting a hard link of the moved file no longer leaves the file behind
The full view no longer holds up thumbnails while a large picture loads
The mosaic's scrollbar no longer covers the thumbnails
